subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh the open fork cleanup PR, replace it with a narrow same-repo fix, or reject Google Chat silent-turn placeholder cleanup?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible on current main, but a fork PR already references this issue with closing syntax and needs a maintainer path choice before automation creates duplicate work.

options.title: Review or replace the cleanup PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 if it can be refreshed with proof, or open a narrow replacement that wires Google Chat placeholder cleanup into the silent-turn lifecycle.

options.title: Reject reaction-only cleanup
options.body: Close the candidate and this issue only if maintainers decide reaction-only `NO_REPLY` turns should not consume Google Chat's typing placeholder.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the cleanup PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 if it can be refreshed with proof, or open a narrow replacement that wires Google Chat placeholder cleanup into the silent-turn lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the current Google Chat reply-delivery helper and adjacent tests.
